name: PM Scholarship Scheme
purpose: Financial assistance to children of ex-servicemen and ex-coast guard personnel for higher education.
intendedBeneficiaries: Students who are dependents of ex-servicemen / ex-coast guard
benefits: Scholarship of up to ₹3,000 per month for boys and ₹3,500 per month for girls.
requiredDocuments: Mark sheets of last qualifying exam
applicationProcess: Visit the official Kendriya Sainik Board portal
Register with valid email and mobile
Fill the application form with personal and academic details

name: National Means-cum-Merit Scholarship
purpose: Award scholarships to meritorious students of economically weaker sections to arrest their drop out at class 8.
intendedBeneficiaries: Class 8 students from economically weaker sections
benefits: ₹12,000 per annum (₹1,000 per month) for 4 years from Class 9 to Class 12.
applicationProcess: Contact school for NMMS examination notification
Fill the application form available at school
Qualifying students receive scholarship directly in bank account

name: Pre-Matric Scholarship for SC Students
nameHindi: एससी छात्रों के लिए प्री-मैट्रिक स्कॉलरशिप
ministry: Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment
purpose: Support educational attainment of SC students at the pre-matriculation stage.
intendedBeneficiaries: SC students studying in Classes 9 and 10
benefits: Scholarship of ₹3,500 per year for 10 months plus additional allowances.
applicationProcess: Register on the National Scholarship Portal
Fill in academic and family details
Upload documents and submit at the institute for verification

name: Ayushman Bharat PM-JAY
ministry: Ministry of Health and Family Welfare
purpose: Health coverage of up to ₹5 lakh per family per year for secondary and tertiary hospitalisation.
intendedBeneficiaries: Poor and vulnerable families as per SECC 2011 database
benefits: Cashless health cover of ₹5,00,000 per family per year at empanelled hospitals.
applicationProcess: Visit nearest CSC or empanelled hospital
Verify eligibility using Aadhaar or Ration card
Use card at any empanelled hospital for cashless treatment

name: Janani Suraksha Yojana
ministry: Ministry of Health and Family Welfare
purpose: Reduce maternal and neonatal mortality by promoting institutional delivery among pregnant women.
intendedBeneficiaries: All pregnant women in rural areas (19+ years)
benefits: Cash assistance of ₹1,400 in rural areas and ₹1,000 in urban areas for institutional delivery.
applicationProcess: Register at the ANM/ASHA worker during pregnancy
Go for institutional delivery at a government facility
Cash assistance credited to bank account

name: PM-Kisan Samman Nidhi
ministry: Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare
purpose: Provide income support to all landholding farmer families for meeting agricultural and allied needs.
benefits: ₹6,000 per year in three equal instalments of ₹2,000 each directly to bank accounts.
applicationProcess: Visit the PM-Kisan portal or nearest Common Service Centre
Benefit is credited directly to bank account in instalments

name: PM Fasal Bima Yojana
ministry: Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare
purpose: Provide insurance coverage and financial support to farmers in case of crop failure or damage.
intendedBeneficiaries: All farmers growing notified crops in notified areas
benefits: Comprehensive crop insurance with subsidised premium of 1.5-2% for kharif and rabi crops.
applicationProcess: Insurance cover activated for notified crops

name: MGNREGA
purpose: Enhance livelihood security of rural households by providing at least 100 days of guaranteed wage employment.
intendedBeneficiaries: Adult members of rural households willing to do unskilled manual work
benefits: Guaranteed 100 days of wage employment per year at notified wage rates.
applicationProcess: Apply at the local Gram Panchayat
Get Job Card issued within 7 days
Demand work and receive wages in bank account

name: PM Kaushal Vikas Yojana (PMKVY)
ministry: Ministry of Skill Development and Entrepreneurship
purpose: Enable large number of youth to take up industry-relevant skill training for securing better livelihoods.
benefits: Free short-term skill training, certification and placement assistance.
applicationProcess: Get certified and access placement support

name: Startup India
ministry: Department for Promotion of Industry and Internal Trade
purpose: Build a strong ecosystem for nurturing innovation and startups in the country.
benefits: Tax exemptions, easier compliance, government procurement benefits and fund-of-funds support.
applicationProcess: Register on the Startup India portal
Apply for tax benefits and schemes

name: PM Awas Yojana - Gramin
purpose: Provide pucca houses with basic amenities to all houseless and those living in kutcha houses in rural areas.
intendedBeneficiaries: Houseless families and families living in kutcha houses in rural areas
benefits: Financial assistance of ₹1.20 lakh (plain areas) and ₹1.30 lakh (hilly/North-East) for house construction.
requiredDocuments: Land documents / proof of kutcha house
applicationProcess: Visit the PMAY-G portal or Gram Panchayat
Fill the housing application with family and land details
Verification by Gram Sabha and approval

name: PM Awas Yojana - Urban
ministry: Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs
purpose: Provide affordable housing to urban poor including slum dwellers through in-situ rehabilitation and credit-linked subsidy.
intendedBeneficiaries: Economically weaker sections in urban areas
benefits: Interest subsidy on home loans up to ₹6.92 lakh and affordable pucca houses.
applicationProcess: Enter Aadhaar and family income details

name: PM Awas Yojana Urban 2.0
ministry: Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs
purpose: Provide assistance to 1 crore urban poor and middle-class families for permanent housing over 5 years.
intendedBeneficiaries: EWS, LIG and middle-income families without pucca houses in urban areas
benefits: Central assistance of ₹2.03 lakh for BLC and interest subsidy on home loans up to ₹2.5 lakh.
applicationProcess: Enter Aadhaar and family income details

name: Indira Awaas Yojana
purpose: Historic scheme providing financial assistance for construction of houses to BPL rural families.
intendedBeneficiaries: SC/ST and non-SC/ST BPL rural households
benefits: Grant assistance for house construction (now subsumed under PMAY-G).
applicationProcess: Submit BPL certificate and land proof
Verification and approval at Gram Sabha

name: PM Ujjwala Yojana
ministry: Ministry of Petroleum and Natural Gas
purpose: Provide clean cooking fuel (LPG) to women from BPL households to replace unhealthy cooking fuels.
benefits: Free LPG connection with first refill and stove; subsidised refills.
applicationProcess: Receive free LPG connection and stove

name: Sukanya Samriddhi Yojana
purpose: Encourage parents to build a corpus for the future education and marriage of their girl child.
benefits: High-interest savings account with tax benefits; 8.2% interest (FY 2024-25) and tax-free maturity.
applicationProcess: Visit post office or authorised bank
Submit birth certificate and guardian documents
Open SSY account in girl child's name
Deposit annually until 15 years from opening

name: Indira Gandhi National Old Age Pension Scheme
nameHindi: इंदिरा गांधी राष्ट्रीय वृद्धावस्था पेंशन योजना
purpose: Provide monthly pension to BPL persons aged 60 years and above.
benefits: Monthly pension of ₹200 (60-79 years) and ₹500 (80+ years), with state top-ups.
applicationProcess: Apply at the Block Development Office or online
Pension credited monthly to bank account

name: Indira Gandhi National Widow Pension Scheme
nameHindi: इंदिरा गांधी राष्ट्रीय विधवा पेंशन योजना
purpose: Provide monthly pension to widows aged 40-79 years from BPL households.
benefits: Monthly pension of ₹300 with possible state government top-ups.
applicationProcess: Apply at Block Office or Gram Panchayat
Submit husband's death certificate and BPL proof
Pension credited monthly to bank account

name: Ladli Laxmi Yojana
purpose: Improve the educational and health status of girl children and encourage positive attitude towards the girl child.
intendedBeneficiaries: Girl children born to BPL families
benefits: Accumulated fund of ₹1.18 lakh paid in instalments from Class 6 to graduation (subject to conditions).
applicationProcess: Apply through Anganwadi centre or online portal
Register the girl child within one year of birth
Passbook issued and instalments paid from Class 6 onwards

name: National Apprenticeship Training Scheme
purpose: Provide practical training to technically qualified youth in central/state/industrial organisations.
intendedBeneficiaries: Graduates, diploma holders and certificate holders in technical/vocational streams
benefits: One to two years of apprenticeship training with monthly stipend of ₹5,000-₹9,000.
applicationProcess: Get selected and start training with stipend

name: Stand-Up India
purpose: Facilitate bank loans between ₹10 lakh and ₹1 crore to SC/ST and women entrepreneurs for setting up greenfield enterprises.
benefits: Bank loans of ₹10 lakh to ₹1 crore with 7-year repayment and possible margin money support.
applicationProcess: Loan sanctioned and disbursed with handholding support

name: PM Jeevan Jyoti Bima Yojana
purpose: Provide life insurance cover to bank account holders at affordable premium.
benefits: Life insurance cover of ₹2,00,000 at annual premium of ₹436.
applicationProcess: Annual premium auto-debited from savings account

name: PM Suraksha Bima Yojana
purpose: Provide accident insurance cover to bank account holders at highly affordable premium.
benefits: Accidental death and disability cover of ₹2,00,000 at annual premium of ₹20.

name: Post-Matric Scholarship for OBC Students
nameHindi: ओबीसी छात्रों के लिए पोस्ट-मैट्रिक स्कॉलरशिप
ministry: Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment
purpose: Provide financial assistance to OBC students for post-matriculation studies.
intendedBeneficiaries: OBC students studying at post-matriculation level
benefits: Maintenance allowance, reimbursement of compulsory non-refundable fees and study tour charges.
applicationProcess: Institute verifies and forwards to disbursing authority

name: PM Shram Yogi Maandhan Yojana
purpose: Provide old age pension to unorganised sector workers through contributory pension scheme.
intendedBeneficiaries: Unorganised sector workers aged 18-40 with monthly income up to ₹15,000
benefits: Assured monthly pension of ₹3,000 after age 60 with equal government contribution.

name: National Food Security Act
ministry: Ministry of Consumer Affairs, Food and Public Distribution
purpose: Provide highly subsidised food grains to eligible households under the Public Distribution System.
intendedBeneficiaries: BPL and Antyodaya Anna Yojana households
benefits: 5 kg food grains per person per month at ₹1-3 per kg; AAY households get 35 kg per family.
applicationProcess: Apply at the local rationing/Food & Civil Supplies office
Get ration card issued post verification
Collect subsidised food grains from FPS

name: Beti Bachao Beti Padhao
ministry: Ministry of Women and Child Development
purpose: Address declining Child Sex Ratio and promote education and empowerment of the girl child.
benefits: Awareness generation, education promotion and conditional cash benefits through linked schemes.
applicationProcess: Avail benefits through linked schemes like Sukanya Samriddhi

name: Pre-Matric Scholarship for Minorities
purpose: Encourage parents from minority communities to send their children to school and support their studies.
benefits: Admission fee and maintenance allowance up to ₹1,070 per month depending on class and course.
applicationProcess: Institute verifies and forwards the application
